texts.preamble: Ravindra Singh Son Of Daljeet Singh vs State Of Rajasthan on 6 January, 2022 Author: Farjand Ali Bench: Farjand Ali High Court Of Judicature For Rajasthan Bench At Jaipur S.B. Criminal Miscellaneous (Petition) No. 2512/2021 Ravindra Singh Son Of Daljeet Singh, R/o 1017, Chanakya Puri Near Sheela Cinema Rohatak Haryana. ----Petitioner Versus State Of Rajasthan, Through P.p. ----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Mr. A.K. Khan, through Vc. For Respondent(s) : Mr. Arvind Kumar, Pp. Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Farjand Ali Order 06/01/2022
texts.facts: Brief facts of the case is that the petitioner was facing the trial under Section 7 read with 16 of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act. Owing to some inevitable circumstances, he failed to appear before the trial court and therefore his bail bonds were forfeited and thereafter on 21.07.2018 he has been declared absconder. The petitioner has moved an application under Section 70(2) of the Cr.P.C. for the conversion of warrant of arrest into bailable warrant but the same has been dismissed by the learned ACJM No.2 Kota vide order dated 07.01.2021.
texts.arguments: Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is ready and willing to appear before the Court but apprehends (2 of 2) [CRLMP-2512/2021] that in the event of surrender before the Ravindra Singh Son Of Daljeet Singh vs State Of Rajasthan on 6 January, 2022 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/46850119/ 1 Court, he shall be taken into custody, he is a poor person and the responsibility of the entire family is upon him. If he would be kept behind the bars, the entire family would be starving. Counsel further submits that the petitioner assured that henceforth he shall not impede the smooth trial and would regularly appear before the trial Court, physically or through his counsel, if one opportunity is granted to him.
